sentence_stem: If I had studied harder last year,
correct_completion: I would be working as an engineer now.
full_sentence: If I had studied harder last year, I would be working as an engineer now.
acceptable_variants: I would have a better job now.
I would earn more money today.

options.why_wrong: A present ability does not match the mixed conditional result, which requires 'would' plus a present result.

options.text: I will get a good job tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' with 'tomorrow' does not complete a mixed conditional, which describes a present result of a past condition.

options.text: I would be working as an engineer now.
I worked as an engineer last year.
options.why_wrong: The past simple describes what really happened, not the imagined present result that the mixed conditional expresses.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditional: if + past perfect, would + base verb for a present result
explanation: The stem uses 'if' with a past perfect form to describe an unreal past condition. The result clause refers to the present, so it needs 'would' plus a base verb with a present time reference.
translation: Якби я краще вчився минулого року, зараз я працював би інженером.
